# temps_shield_token (Resource)

A token that lets automated clients (CI, monitoring) bypass Shield challenges for an environment, or the whole project with `project_wide`. The secret is only available when the token is created.

Import with `<project_id>/<environment_id>/<id>`.

Required API key permissions: `projects:read`, `projects:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_shield_token" "ci" {
  project_id     = temps_project.web.id
  environment_id = temps_environment.staging.id
  name           = "ci"
}

output "shield_token" {
  value     = temps_shield_token.ci.secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (Number) ID of the environment.
- `name` (String) Name of the token.
- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project.

### Optional

- `project_wide` (Boolean) Accept the token in every environment of the project. Temps never returns it, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `<project_id>/<environment_id>/<id>`.
- `scope` (String) `environment` or `project`.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Token value. Only known when Terraform created the token; an imported token has none.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <project_id>/<environment_id>/<id>
terraform import temps_shield_token.ci 8/21/3
```
